pages.text: Sends a POST request: sends data to the server, e.g. to create something.$(br2)The data is sent as UTF-8. Set its type in the $(1)Content-Type$() header of the connection. Make the data with TO_JSON of c0de/strings.

$(li)$(1)connection$() STRUCT c0de_net/http/HTTP_CONNECTION: the server$(li)$(1)endpoint$() STRING: the path behind the base endpoint (optional, default empty)$(li)$(1)data$() STRING: the data sent with the request (optional, default empty)$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the raw data of the answer
$(li)result $(1)status$() INTEGER: the HTTP status$(li)result $(1)headers$() HASH STRING: the headers of the answer
$(1)CALL c0de_net/http/HTTP_POST$(br)  PARAMETER connection api ;$(br)  PARAMETER endpoint "/messages" ;$(br)  PARAMETER data message ;$(br)  RESULT result answer$()
